From White Album · Price: integrated only; you can't swim while wearing it, and it melts in heat.

Theme Force and Energy · Stand type integrated only

  • 1: 1 action: wear ice armor: +1 circumstance bonus to AC (+2 from 9th), and creatures that hit you with a melee Strike take cold damage equal to your level.
  • 5: You can skate: +10 ft Speed on flat ground.
  • 9: Surge: freeze the air in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-ft emanation}: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[cold]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 13: Reaction: freeze an incoming projectile so it shatters (attack misses), once per round.
  • 17: Absolute cold: creatures that start their turn adjacent to you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.MeW64XQeyUUZ687p]{Effect: Ice Armor}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
